text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 — dedicated pool eu-west-1-pool-12: p99 latency spiked to 3.2s (>3s SLO) for 12m. Queue depth growing. Streaming stalls observed. Auto-page: @maria.

maria: ack, oncall up. quick triage — is this localized to eu-west or multi-region? visible customer impact? :eyes:

aj: seeing region-localized to eu-west-1. publishing quick metrics. infra-bot will paste short graph.

infra-bot: metrics snapshot: p95=420ms, p99=3.2s, streaming-inflight-conns +38% in last 10m, pool available slots down from 14->6. queue-depth: 87 -> 430.

maria: logs pls. any autoscaler errors? warmup failures?

aj: digging, posting autoscaler logs excerpt:
```
[autoscaler] 2026-06-12T09:02:14Z ERROR slot-registration timeout id=pool12-slot-83 after=15000ms
[autoscaler] 2026-06-12T09:02:14Z WARN handshake_jitter detected seq=5 jitter_ms=1800
[warmup] 2026-06-12T09:02:15Z ERROR warmup failed model=redwood-large reason=kv-cache-initialize-timeout
```

aj: also seeing frequent TLS handshake retries between control-plane and pool proxies right before slot-registration timeouts.

sachin: that matches streaming stalls pattern — cold pool warmups not finishing and requests forced onto fewer hot slots -> tail queues and streaming stalls. hypothesis: control-plane handshake jitter + warmup dependency (kv cache init) blocking registration.

anna-cs: we have 3 customers reporting degraded streaming experience (ticket #CS-5789, CS-5790, CS-5791). Customers seeing stalled streams, partial responses, and reconnects. Support has reached out, telling them engineering is investigating.

maria: immediate mitigations: (1) force additional slots into pool (bypass normal handshake if possible), (2) failover streaming route to eu-central fallback pool for most affected customers, (3) reduce warmup parallelism to avoid NFS/kv contention. I'll coordinate.

aj: triggering scale command now:
```
infra-cli scale pool eu-west-1-pool-12 --min-instances 10 --force-warmup --bypass-registration-fallback=true
```

deploy-bot: scale job submitted -> job_id=scale-1769823465. Will post updates.

infra-bot: running quick check on KV backend (redis-nfs-proxy). Seeing elevated latency on kv-init RPCs around same window (tail 99th = 2.1s). NFS mounts on warmup hosts show intermittent iowait.

sachin: given kv-init is part of warmup, high iowait could cause warmups to exceed registration timeout. two short-term options: (A) increase slot-registration timeout to tolerate jitter, (B) reduce warmup work (skip kv prefetch) for this pool temporarily. prefer (B) for immediate symptom relief.

maria: agreed. aj, can you flip warmup mode to 'minimal' for pool-12?

aj: executing:
```
infra-cli apply-config pool eu-west-1-pool-12 --warmup-mode minimal --warmup-parallelism 2
```

aj: also bumped registration timeout to 30s as safety net.

infra-bot: config applied. warmup-mode minimal active. registration timeout increased -> 30s.

support-ops: updating CS notes: telling customers we have a mitigation in progress, recommending they switch streaming to fallback region if latency critical.

deploy-bot: scale job completed. pool target instances increased to 10. Warmup rollouts started.

maria: monitoring p95/p99 and queue depth. please post p99 every 60s.

infra-bot: p95=360ms, p99=1.9s, queue-depth trending down 430 -> 210.

sachin: better but tail still elevated. streaming stalls reduced but not gone. any streaming-specific router logs?

aj: router logs show increased reconnects due to partial payload timeouts around framing stage. snippet:
```
[stream-router] WARN stream-id=abc123 client=acct-987 partial-frame-timeout=2500ms
[stream-router] INFO failover candidate eu-central-2 used for 12 requests
```

maria: initiating targeted failover for customers with >50% streaming errors to eu-central-2 fallback pools. sachin, can you coordinate traffic-shift rules? keep 10% across pool-12 to observe behavior.

sachin: doing gradual shift. 10% -> 30% -> 60% over next 6 min if metrics improve.

sre-lead: parallel note — we should check control-plane cert rotation logs. earlier similar incident traced to a cert reload creating short TLS handshake GC on the router side. Can infra check cert rotations in last 30m?

aj: cert rotation job ran 42 minutes ago, but rotation logs show retries across some proxies. attaching excerpt:
```
[cert-rotator] 2026-06-12T08:52:10Z INFO rotate cert=pool-proxy-eu-west-1 result=ok
[proxy] WARN tls-handshake retry id=proxy-11 reason=read-eof
```

aj: possibility: rotation retried on a subset of proxies causing jitter, combined with NFS iowait -> warmup contention -> registration timeouts.

maria: OK. immediate customer comms: update status page to 'degraded performance' for eu-west streaming and link to CS tickets. support-ops please post.

support-ops: status updated -> status.redwood.com incident: eu-west streaming degraded. noted affected customers and mitigation steps.

infra-bot: warmup wave 1 finished; new instances reporting healthy but with minimal warmup (kv-prefetch skipped). p99 dropped to 1.2s. queue-depth 210 -> 80.

anna-cs: customers acknowledged initial mitigation, one customer requested a SLA credit path; CS is collecting impacted request ids.

maria: plan for next 60m: continue monitoring p95/p99, let minimal-warmup run, keep registration timeout at 30s, and prepare for full warmup once KV backend iowait resolved. schedule post-incident follow-ups: (1) upgrade warmup to be resilient to kv-latency (async init), (2) add circuit-breaker to avoid slot-registration blocking on kv-init, (3) investigate cert-rotator retry behavior.

sachin: I'll own postmortem draft. taking next 45m of oncall. maria handing off now. key logs and commands in thread.

maria: handing off — @sachin oncall from 09:10 -> 09:55. leaving notes: root cause hypothesis = control-plane handshake jitter during cert rotation combined with kv-init iowait causing warmup -> registration timeouts -> pool starvation -> tail latency and streaming stalls.

oncall-pagerduty: paging handoff recorded.

sre-lead: good mitigation. next steps: add a short-term runbook entry for 'hot-pool warmup bypass' and long-term fix for decoupling slot-registration from heavy warmup tasks. I'll create ticket and assign to infra + runtime.

maria: thanks team. I'll follow up with incident severity update and update postmortem owners. leaving channel. :wave:
